import nki
import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def tensor_avgpool_kernel(x, pool_size):
    C, H, W = x.shape
    p = pool_size
    out_shape = (C, H // p, W // p)
    out = nl.ndarray(out_shape, dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    tile = nl.ndarray((C, H, W), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=x)
    
    # Compute the average over the pooling window
    # Reshape to (C, H//p, p, W//p, p)
    # Then compute mean over the last two dimensions
    # Use tile view with strided access
    # Loop over all tiles in the output shape
    # For each tile, compute the sum and divide by p*p
    
    # Allocate a psum tile for accumulation
    psum_tile = nl.ndarray((C, 1, 1), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.psum)
    
    # Loop over all channels
    for c in nl.affine_range(C):
        # Loop over all output height positions
        for h in nl.affine_range(H // p):
            # Loop over all output width positions
            for w in nl.affine_range(W // p):
                # Compute the sum over the pooling window
                # View the tile as (C, H//p, p, W//p, p)
                # Extract the window
                window = tile[c, h*p:(h+1)*p, w*p:(w+1)*p]
                s = nl.sum(window, axis=[1, 2], keepdims=True)
                # Scale by 1/(p*p)
                nisa.tensor_scalar(dst=psum_tile[c], data=s, op0=nl.multiply, operand0=1.0 / (p * p))
    
    # Copy the result from psum to shared_hbm
    nisa.tensor_copy(dst=out, src=psum_tile)
    return out

    p = pool_size
    out_shape = (C, H // p, W // p)
    out = nl.ndarray(out_shape, dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    t = nl.ndarray((C, H, W), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)

    # Compute the average over the pool windows

    # Then take mean over the last two axes
